arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Yoimiya from Genshin Impact.
Image 1 is the user-supplied in-game model screenshot and is the authoritative reference for character identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, exact costume construction, accessory placement and body proportions. Faithfully preserve its warm blond updo and hair ornaments, amber-gold eyes, earrings, exact asymmetrical orange kimono, white bandage wraps, arm markings, red rope loop on her back, belt and pouches, patterned hanging cloth, uneven leg guards, ribbons and sandals. Use the model's real costume colors without copying the blue environmental lighting or screenshot background. Hair and heavy hanging costume panels should fall naturally with gravity.
Image 2 is the installed official illustrated portrait, for ART STYLE ONLY: polished Genshin-inspired anime illustration, clean drawn contours, detailed cel shading with soft painted transitions, and its treatment of hair, fabric, metal and other materials. Do not copy the portrait's dramatic action pose, windblown panels or accessories that differ from the model. Image 1 governs all design and costume details.
Proportions: choose a moderately petite Medium Female anime build, between a normally proportioned small-framed figure and an especially compact cute figure. Keep a small delicate frame and gently compact torso, with natural arm and leg length that is only slightly shortened from the in-game model. The head should be only modestly larger relative to the body, retaining a soft cute face without making it oversized. Give her more natural torso and limb length than an extremely petite or compressed design, while keeping her clearly petite rather than tall and long-legged. Preserve a balanced standard anime silhouette and the exact model costume. Achieve this through anatomy, not extra empty canvas space.
Character-specific neutral acting: a sunny, approachable idle with a bright but gentle smile and open lively eyes. Give her a slight friendly head tilt, one hand lifted in a small open-palmed greeting near her shoulder and the other resting casually at her waist. A lively small weight shift, feet grounded and uncrossed. Do not add fireworks, a bow or other props.
Keep hand gestures simple, spatially separate, near the torso and near the image plane, with coherent wrists and one thumb and four fingers per hand where visible. Exactly two legs and two feet. Keep the face and eyes readable with the character's normal pupils. Complete silhouette including hair, headwear, hands, sleeves, costume panels, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding and 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background. Omit all screenshot scenery, blue backdrop, UI, particles, floor and reflection. No text, labels, watermarks, ground shadow, floating effects, new props or additional characters.
